title: Harden subtitle and audio output verification
summary: Phase 1 resolved-plan output verification and BDPGS default hardening are implemented; normalized conversion-result persistence and real-media acceptance remain open.
reason: Block silent audio/subtitle output loss or disposition drift before publish while preserving explicit operator settings and backend policy ownership.
behavior_before: Audio and subtitle verification was split and incomplete; BDPGS OCR default authorities disagreed and missing configuration could fail validation before runtime default resolution.
behavior_after: Encode and remux use a resolved-plan ffprobe verifier that blocks publish on track mismatch; BDPGS OCR defaults true only when absent and explicit false persists.
manual_validation: 2026-07-10: Tdarr proof-pack run subtitle-audio-safety-aac-ac3-eac3-20260710-r2 passed all three selected remux cases with zero audit findings. Evidence: E:\Videos\TdarrMatrix\ProofPack\runs\subtitle-audio-safety-aac-ac3-eac3-20260710-r2\manifests\audit\tdarr_matrix_audit_report.json. Coverage is AAC, E-AC-3, and AC-3 two-track/default-disposition remux only; it does not satisfy subtitle/OCR, encode, deferred-publish, or Plex playback acceptance.
